facts.headline: What is Assisted Tree Migration? Helping Forests Keep Up with Climate Change
facts.summary: Assisted tree migration is the deliberate relocation of tree species into regions that suit a warming climate, helping forests that can't move fast enough on their own. This explainer covers why trees get stranded, real-world examples, and the ethical and ecological risks of replanting a continent by hand.
